ruleDefinitions.name: HackTool - Empire UserAgent URI Combo
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects user agent and URI paths used by empire agents Note: Unmapped fields: c-useragent, cs-uri, cs-method

sequences.query: (c-useragent = "Mozilla\/5\.0\ \(Windows\ NT\ 6\.1\;\ WOW64\;\ Trident\/7\.0\;\ rv\:11\.0\)\ like\ Gecko" AND (cs-uri = "\/admin\/get\.php" OR cs-uri = "\/news\.php" OR cs-uri = "\/login\/process\.php") AND cs-method = "POST")
